$comment: Acceptance suite configuration. Edit to change sizes, timeouts or which scenarios run.

large-file.title: Large file, multi-connection
large-file.description: A file well beyond the segment size, fetched with several connections, verified byte-for-byte against a single-connection fetch.

range-multipart.title: Range support, multipart
range-multipart.description: Origin honours byte ranges; the transfer must issue several ranged requests and assemble them correctly.

no-range-downgrade.title: No Range: fall back to a single stream
no-range-downgrade.description: Origin advertises Accept-Ranges but answers 200 to every ranged request. The engine must detect this, discard the torn attempt and re-download as one stream.

redirect-chain.title: Redirect chain
redirect-chain.description: Five 302 hops before the body. The final bytes must be identical to a direct fetch.

custom-headers.title: Custom request headers
custom-headers.description: Origin refuses requests missing an expected header. With the header supplied the download must succeed; without it, it must fail rather than silently save an error page.

interrupt-resume.title: Interrupt and resume
interrupt-resume.description: Stop the transfer partway, keep the per-segment state, then resume. The resumed result must match the uninterrupted hash, and the origin must not re-serve the whole file. The origin is throttled so the interruption reliably lands mid-transfer.

rate-limit.title: Rate limiting
rate-limit.description: A per-task speed cap must hold the observed throughput near the configured rate.

error-retry.title: Transient errors and retry
error-retry.description: The origin fails the first three RANGED requests with 503 (transfer phase), then serves normally. The engine must retry and still complete with the correct hash.

sha256-verify.title: SHA-256 verification
sha256-verify.description: The origin publishes a Content-Digest. The engine must verify the assembled file against it, and reject a file that does not match.
